mission: Mission 4 — Efficient Small-Object Detection, Error Recovery & Adaptive Inference Under Adverse Weather

Group_C.role: Permanently locked external evaluation test cohort (zero leakage, zero tuning)

hypotheses.H1: A detector can identify images that need higher-resolution inference without applying expensive high-resolution processing to every image.
hypotheses.H2: Adaptive high-resolution inference can recover a meaningful proportion of small-object misses while using less average computation than always running at 1280px.
hypotheses.H3: Targeted crop-based refinement can recover missed small objects more efficiently than processing the entire image at high resolution.
hypotheses.H4: Remaining small-object detection errors are influenced by multiple visual factors including sub-pixel scale (<16^2 px^2), severe optical extinction, contrast loss, occlusion, and boundary truncation.
hypotheses.H5: An adaptive inference system can improve the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier compared with fixed-resolution YOLOv8n baselines.
